verdict.rationale: Zep automatically derives AI-generated artifacts from ingested data — thread summaries (zep-docs-8), extracted entities/relations and temporal facts via the Context Graph and Graphiti (zep-docs-3, zep-docs-27, zep-gh-1), and composed context blocks (zep-docs-10) — which qualify as AI-generated insights surfaced back through the API. However, evidence is all developer/API-facing (no end-user UI presenting these insights) and there's no evidence of proactive 'suggestions' or recommendations beyond passive retrieval. Missing for 10: end-user-facing insight/suggestion surfaces (dashboards, proactive recommendations), and independent hands-on validation that these summaries/insights are accurate and useful in practice.
